The 930 million CZK financial instrument takes project intents until 6 January 2027.
notes: Allocation: 930 milionů Kč (SFŽP call page, 'Celkově alokováno finančních prostředků'); the opzp.cz call list shows the same 930 000 000 Kč. Support rate: category 1 — guarantee on 50 % of the guaranteed loan + max. 20 % grant of eligible costs (loan must equal 80 % of CZV); category 2 — guarantee on 50 % + max. 10 % grant (loan must equal 90 % of CZV); guaranteed loan 8 to 500 mil. Kč (same page, 'Výše podpory'). Eligible applicants: businesses in or innovating the circular economy; obce, kraje, svazky obcí and other subjects defined in chapter 3 of the call (same page, 'Kdo může žádat'). Window: průběžná dvoukolová; round 1 project intents 1. 8. 2025 – 6. 1. 2027; round 2 full applications from approval of the intent to 31. 12. 2027; projects must finish by 31. 12. 2029 (same page, 'Termíny'). Provenance: owed by the 2026-09-03 pass (seen, not minted); listed as 'Příjem žádostí probíhá' on https://opzp.cz/nabidka-dotaci/ and in the SFŽP financial-instruments menu. The call opened in 2025 but is live and not in the ledger. Date = close of the intent round, the last date a new project can enter. Call text (update 3): https://sfzp.gov.cz/files/documents/storage/2026/03/24/1774336730_Výzva 1_2025 FN - aktualizace 3.pdf, not read; every fact above is on the HTML page. title: SFZP call 1/2026/NZU FN — interest compensation to banks that lend zero-cost NZU renovation loans
money_note: the call's published allocation is a cap on the VOLUME of subsidised loans, up to 50,000,000,000 CZK lent to final recipients by 2031, converted at 24.340 CZK/EUR, the ČNB daily rate of 18 September 2026; the compensation (subsidy) outlay itself is not published; no EUR figure is published
summary: Banks, building societies and branches of foreign credit institutions in Czechia can sign up to lend Nová zelená úsporám renovation loans on which the borrower pays no interest or fees, with SFŽP compensating the bank at PRIBOR 1M plus a 0.40 to 0.90 percent margin. The call covers up to 50 billion CZK of loans contracted from 16 September 2026 to 31 December 2031.
notes: Allocation: 'až do výše 50 mld. Kč' of subsidised loans to final recipients by 2031 (SFŽP call page, 'Alokace'; same wording in the call PDF). Support rate: compensation paid to the bank = PRIBOR 1M (floored at 0 %) + compensation margin of 0,90 % for unsecured family-house loans, 0,50 % for secured family-house loans, 0,40 % for SVJ/BD loans, act/360 on the compensation principal; the borrower pays no interest or fees during the compensation period (Příloha č. 1 https://sfzp.gov.cz/files/documents/storage/2026/09/16/1789541369_P1_kompenzace.pdf and call text https://sfzp.gov.cz/files/documents/storage/2026/09/16/1789562687_Výzva_NZÚ_1_2026_FN.pdf, both saved as PDF and pdftotext .txt under pages/sfzp-nzu-fn-1-2026-*). Eligible applicants: credit institutions per art. 4(1)(1) of Regulation (EU) 575/2013 (esp. banks incl. building societies) and branches of foreign credit institutions operating in Czechia; final beneficiary is the holder of an NZÚ support decision (call page, 'Kdo může žádat'). Window: loan contracts from 16. září 2026 to 31. prosince 2031 (call page, 'Termíny'). Provenance: new since the 2026-09-03 pass — documents dated 16. 9. 2026 on the SFŽP financial-instruments page. It builds on HOUSEnerg 1/2026 and 2/2026. OVERLAP CHECK for the lead: the ledger's dotace-mf-housenerg-fn-pujcky describes the earlier interest-free NZU loan instrument (HOUSEnerg 1/2024 FN, now on the SFŽP 'Uzavřené výzvy' list); dotace-nzu-2026-zranitelne-domacnosti covers the household-facing NZÚ programme. This record is the new bank-facing call with its own number, window and allocation; merge if the register treats them as one call. Saved as pages/sfzp-fn-vyzva-1-2026-nzu-fn.html.
quote: Alokace Výzvy je stanovena k objemu zvýhodněných úvěrů až do výše 50 mld. Kč poskytovaných Konečným příjemcům do roku 2031.
